messageText: This is My Language App, a freelance project I started in February 2023.

It's a language learning app I built for a client whose son is autistic and has a speech impediment. The idea was to give him a way to build sentences and practice language through custom games made just for him.
I worked directly from the client's designs to bring their vision to life, and built out both the frontend and backend myself.
Quick preview above of how the app works.

Backend is Laravel with Sanctum handling auth. Built a full CRUD API around all the pieces that make up a lesson: vocabulary words, grammar categories and components, sentence formulations, chapters, and levels.
There's also a permissions system with roles (admin, supervisor, regular user) tied to workgroups, so a caregiver or educator can manage content and check on progress without ever touching code.
Spent this stretch on the actual game engine, drag and drop games and multiple choice games, both built to snap sentence pieces together correctly.

Every level and chapter gets assembled from a library of grammar components, so games can be reordered, swapped, and evaluated. There's a whole game evaluation system behind it to score attempts and track how he's doing over time.

On the frontend I built out a full component library in React + TypeScript and documented/tested every piece in Storybook before wiring it into real pages: buttons, cards, dropdowns, modals, snackbars, color pickers, side sheets, all of it.
That made it a lot faster to build the admin pages (users, workgroups, categories, components, formulations) and kept the actual game pages he plays consistent and polished.
Wrapped this one up in October after building it out end to end since Feb. Skill checklist for this project, straight from the source:
Really rewarding project, knowing exactly who was going to be using what I was building.
